means.example-sentence: I think Sakamoto Ryoma was true to his philosophy all his life, and I respect him for that.
means.sentence-jp: 坂本龍馬は生涯自分の哲学に忠実だったと私は思うし, 私はそのことで彼を尊敬している。

cloze.maskedText: I think Sakamoto Ryoma was ____ his philosophy all his life, and I respect him for that.

notes: be は remain となることも多い。
be true to life は『生き写しである・実物大である』。
be true to one's word [promise] は『約束を守る』。
